about: The production LiteDRAM core (both DDR3 channels, DDR3-1066, CL7/CWL6, 512-bit native ports through LiteDRAM's ECC, a BIST per channel, CSRs on an AXI-Lite slave in ctl_clk) with WL7DDRPHY (docs/litedram.md section 8: per channel a WriteClocks MMCM cascaded from sys, the host shifting CK and the commands, the reads captured on the static write clocks; one write clock group; every serializer reset from its own register; per-bit read framing through ddrphy*_dly_sel_bits), generated by tools/litedram/gen_core.py; its csr.csv and sdram_init.py are opentpu/host/litedram/. Check or regenerate: tools/litedram/check_core.sh.
